timeline: You might assume listeners were foolish, but this 1938 radio broadcast fooled people by disguising an alien invasion as breaking news.
Orson Welles staged the fake drama live on CBS.
Dance music was suddenly interrupted by urgent news flashes.
Reporters described strange explosions spotted on the surface of Mars.
Then an unknown object crashed into a New Jersey farm.
Frightened crowds fled into the streets as chaos spread.
Newspapers and public figures expressed widespread outrage in the hours and days that followed.
Welles apologized publicly for creating such a convincing hoax.
The brilliant stunt launched his legendary career in storytelling.
